critique: Flawless execution of the Orchid / 1979 Sony hardware archive aesthetic. The royal blue felt cyclorama, warm amber edge-light on the slate-blue ABS housing, and the coiled black cable with the chrome 1/4-inch TRS jack give it immense tactile authenticity. All 9 upper tick marks are exact with a completely blank bottom arc, single orange hands on each dial, and crisp typography.
